same_sign: Do Video 1 and Video 2 depict the same lexical ASL sign, possibly produced by different signers?
one_feature_pair: Are Video 1 and Video 2 different lexical signs whose annotations differ in exactly one of the 17 selected ASL-LEX fields?
distinguishing_feature: The two lexical signs differ in exactly one of the 17 selected ASL-LEX fields. Which field is the sole difference?
exists_one_feature_pair: Does any pair of different lexical signs among the five displayed videos differ in exactly one of the 17 selected ASL-LEX fields?
universal_shared_feature: Do all five displayed lexical signs have the same annotated value for {field}?
feature_value_counting: How many of the five displayed videos have {field} = {value} in the selected annotation representation?
constraint_satisfaction: Choose the candidate that differs from anchor A only in {field_a} and from anchor B only in {field_b}, preserving every other selected field in each comparison.
feature_transformation: Apply the supplied directed change {source_value} -> {target_value} in {field} to anchor C. Choose the candidate with that change and identical values for every other selected field.
common_neighbor: Choose the candidate that forms a one-feature pair with both anchors. A one-feature pair consists of different lexical signs that differ in exactly one of the 17 selected ASL-LEX fields.
isolate_detection: Choose the unique sign that forms no one-feature pair with any other sign in the five-video set. A one-feature pair consists of different lexical signs differing in exactly one of the 17 selected ASL-LEX fields.
